capabilities: Download architecture artifacts as Markdown notes with frontmatter properties
Fetch and refresh a list of architectures from Cognitive Architect
Preview artifacts and instances before saving
Link artifact notes together and combine them with other vault content
Format artifacts via Templates and build custom views with Dataview
disambiguation: Not a vault-syncing tool; it downloads architecture artifacts from Cognitive Architect into the vault.
extras: The Personal Token cannot be self-generated; users must contact the Cognitive Architect support team to obtain one.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull architecture artifacts from the Cognitive Architect modeling tool into linked, locally stored notes.

relations.evidence: the Community Dataview plugin. Enabled the creation of views in your notes

requires.name: Personal Token from the Cognitive Architect support team

summary: Downloads architectures from Cognitive Architect (IBM IT Architect Assistant) into an Obsidian vault as Markdown notes and images.
